mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.shop_id, o.customer_id, o.channel_code, o.external_order_id, o.country_code, o.currency_code, o.subtotal_amount, o.discount_amount, o.shipping_amount, o.tax_amount, o.total_amount, o.order_status, o.payment_status, o.fulfillment_status, o.after_sale_status, o.coupon_code, o.placed_at, o.paid_at, o.cancelled_at, o.completed_at, o.cancel_reason, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark, c.display_name as customer_name, s.shop_name as shop_name from orders o left join customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id left join shop s on s.shop_id = o.shop_id
mapper.insert: insert into orders (order_no, shop_id, customer_id, channel_code, external_order_id, country_code, currency_code, subtotal_amount, discount_amount, shipping_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, order_status, payment_status, fulfillment_status, after_sale_status, coupon_code, placed_at, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{orderNo}, #{shopId}, #{customerId}, #{channelCode}, #{externalOrderId}, #{countryCode}, #{currencyCode}, #{subtotalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{shippingAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{paymentStatus}, #{fulfillmentStatus}, #{afterSaleStatus}, #{couponCode}, #{placedAt}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update orders set order_status = #{toStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId} and order_status = #{fromStatus}
update orders set payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
update orders set fulfillment_status = #{fulfillmentStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
update orders set after_sale_status = #{afterSaleStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
update orders set external_order_id = #{externalOrderId}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
update orders set paid_at = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
update orders set cancelled_at = sysdate(), cancel_reason = #{reason}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
update orders set completed_at = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from orders where payment_status in ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED') and fulfillment_status in ('UNFULFILLED', 'PARTIALLY_FULFILLED') and order_status not in ('CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED') and shop_id = #{shopId}

select date_format(placed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as salesAmount, count(*) as orderCount from orders where placed_at > date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and payment_status in ('PAID', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED') and shop_id = #{shopId} group by date_format(placed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') order by statDate
